quests.title: In Expert Company? (II)

dialogue.t: No problem. Our box is waterproof. All we need to do is dive down and fetch it...
Boss, none of us here knows how to dive.
I know how to swim, but diving's beyond me.
Is... is the commission we posted at the Adventurers' Guild still on the board?
Boss, didn't you say before that we should hurry up and take the commission down?
We did that yesterday. The guild said they can return us our prepaid commission posting fee today.
Uh... If we want to send out a commission again, are we going to need to pay an additional service fee...

dialogue.sit: Have you guys finished your film?
What are you guys doing here?

dialogue.t: Adventurer... {NICKNAME}! You came right when we needed you!
Can you dive? Or... can you help me find a diver with the ability and time to do a dive?

dialogue.sit: You want to... do an underwater shoot?

dialogue.t: We're hardly that capable. We also can't afford water-proof film equipment.
It's purely because the box we put our films in fell into the water.
Alright, that's enough you two! {NICKNAME}, you gotta help us.
Don't worry about the payment. I'll pay you upfront, just like last time.
*sigh* I hope the films won't be damaged by the water.
Don't worry Boss, the box is sealed tight. The water won't be getting in.
Good thing our Film Kamera didn't fall in. Otherwise, it would be a total flop...
Aha! You're the best, {NICKNAME}. You're the absolute best!
If it weren't for you, everything inside the case would have been lost.
We need to get back to the city and give these films to Mr. Geisert.
And then... let's have a meal together. {NICKNAME}, if you're interested, you can come too.
After we finish eating, I'll pay you your reward.

dialogue.sit: Well, I just happen to be hungry.

dialogue.t: Alright! It's settled.
Yifeng, bring the films in this box over to Mr. Geisert later.
Xingye, go get some good greens from nearby. I've been practicing my Poisson Seafood Soup, and it's time to show it off to Mr. Geisert.
Boss, we're already going to the restaurant. Why do you still get to do things yourself?
So that we can save costs...
Ahem! It's settled. Let's get going.
{NICKNAME}, you can follow me.
This pot is pretty strange. Hmm... but it should be used the same way as the ones in Liyue.
Boss, I got the veggies, but they're all out of Marcotte.
I couldn't find any other store that sells it...
That's... the last ingredient we needed. Well, uh, {NICKNAME}...
Thanks for your help. Don't worry, I know how adventurers work. This isn't a free favor.
{NICKNAME}, did you get the Marcotte?
Okay, gotta get this meal started as soon as possible. Gotta do this fast. Mr. Geisert is almost here...
{NICKNAME}, I'd like to introduce you to a master filmmaker, Mr. Geisert.
Mr. Geisert, this is {NICKNAME}, a highly skilled adventurer.
If you plan to shoot an action film in the future, you should definitely consider casting {NICKNAME} as the lead!
Haha, Ms. Qiu exaggerates. I'm not some filmmaking expert.
I'm just someone who's somewhat familiar with the uses of lighting for filmmaking.
Ah, you're too modest. The lighting in your films practically speaks for itself.

dialogue.sit: Is lighting very important in filmmaking?

dialogue.t: Yeah. In my lighting theory, I believe that the manipulation of lighting is the manipulation of emotion.
But... how should I put this... My theories have yet to be regarded in Fontaine's film industry.
Most directors prefer to use direct movement or the scene itself to illustrate their stories.
I've shot a few films purely using lighting transitions to express narrative, but almost no one was interested.
But now, at least one director thinks my lighting theory has value.
Director? Me? Hahaha, don't jest. I was just a tea vendor.
Who said a tea vendor can't be a director? I was just a journalist before.
A journalist... Then you must be good at writing reports? Just like those in the papers.
I suppose. What about it?
Huh... Just as well...
Ah! Nothing, nothing. Let's eat! We will have plenty of time to work together in the future, hahaha!

dialogue.sit: Everyone takes a seat to Ms. Qiu's forthright laughter.
After the meal, Ms. Qiu makes an additional meal and stuffs it in your bag after packaging it...

quests.description: Ms. Qiu’s group seems to be in trouble again…
